system.description: When you choose this tradition at 2nd Level, you gain the ability to learn ninjutsu with the Earth Release Keyword. If you already have access to this nature release, you learn 2 Earth Release Ninjutsu that you qualify for, one of which can be C-Rank or lower. You can also learn and create Ninjutsu with the Earth Release Keyword in half the required time. Also, Earthen Artifacts you conjure can have an AC of 10, and 10 Hit Points if you choose, if neither statistic is established in its method of summoning, being destroyed/dispelled when it reached 0 hit points.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
